localChanges: In Civilization II games, the Civilopedia's Fortress, Airbase and Farmland pages now say what they do: a Fortress doubles a land unit's defense outside a city and speeds healing, an Airbase repairs and refuels aircraft, and Farmland adds half again to its square's food in a city with a Supermarket (#1272).

In Civilization II games, the Road, Railroad and Pollution pages also say how units move along a Road or Railroad, what Pollution does to its square, what causes it, and how long Settlers take to clean it up (#621).

log: Each pollution tile-yield rule describes tile_yield_halved for its yield, so the Civilopedia's Pollution page can say it halves the square's food, shields and trade (civ-clone/web-renderer#621).

The Supermarket's tile-yield rule also describes square_yield_percent on Farmland, and the pollution rule caused_by on Pollution, so the Civilopedia's Farmland and Pollution pages can say them (civ-clone/web-renderer#1272, civ-clone/web-renderer#621).

The city-road and city-railroad rules describe route_squares and route_free; the strength rule a Fortress's square_defence_multiplier; the heal rule a Fortress's faster resting and an Airbase's full repair of aircraft; the Airbase refuel rule refuels; and the Airbase and Clean Pollution job rules build_turns and removal_turns, so the Civilopedia's tile improvement pages can say them (civ-clone/web-renderer#1272, civ-clone/web-renderer#621).
